scripts.dev:client: cd apps/client && bun run prepare && bun run dev
scripts.dev:server: cd apps/server && bun run prepare && bun run dev
scripts.build:client: cd apps/client && bun run prepare && bun run build
scripts.build:server: cd apps/server && bun run prepare && bun run build
scripts.build: bun run build:client && bun run build:server
scripts.deploy: docker compose --parallel 1 build && docker compose up -d --wait
